headlines.detail: LSU committed $25-30M on roster. Oklahoma State leads FBS with 50 incoming transfers under new HC Eric Morris. January-only portal window compressed bidding and drove costs higher.

headlines.detail: Eight new at-large spots expected to flow to ACC, Big Ten, Big 12, and SEC. ~$300M in beer/spirits sponsorships funds the expansion. Michigan won 2026 men's title; UCLA won women's.
